text:
Anika: Hey folks! Low-effort holiday fun idea: Office Mug + Cookie Swap next Wednesday during lunch? :cookie: :mug: 
Anika: No Secret Santa complexity, just bring a decorated mug (or wrapped new mug) + a batch of cookies/recipe card. Leave on the kitchen table by 12:15.
Tom: Love it. Can we do dietary tags? (vegan / gluten-free / nut-free).
Anika: Yes please label with simple tags e.g., `GF`, `V`, `NF` and a short note if contains nuts.
Lila: I'm in. bringing my annual ginger-snap flop but people always forgive it. :joy:
Omar: also in. can I include a small sticky note with a silly holiday pun on each mug?
Anika: 100% yes. Puns encouraged.
Kate: remote people — can we do a take-home shipping option? I can coordinate a care-package pickup.
Mara: If remote, DM me high-res photo of your mug + we'll add your name to the digital gallery and send you a $10 coffee e-gift if you ship a physical cookie pack.
KitchenBot: Event created: "Mug & Cookie Swap" 12/22 12:00-13:00 PT. RSVP list updated.
Tom: Quick format for sign-up (paste comment):
```
file: mug_tom.jpg
cookies: cinnamon stars (V)
notes: nut-free, can reheat
```
Lila: Love the format. Adding my entry now.
Omar: will people actually eat my cookies or just take pictures? asking for a friend. :grimacing: 
Anika: Both. We will have tasting plates and a 'mug match' table. People can take one cookie serving plus grab a mug (mugs can be new or used — label if you want it back).
Kate: Is this company-sponsored? I can chip in $50 for some extra napkins / disposable plates.
Anika: Nice—if Ops OKs we can use $50 from events budget. Mara, can you confirm?
Mara: Confirmed. We can cover napkins + a handful of reusable bamboo plates. Also will buy allergy-safe labels.
Tom: Are there rules about offensive mugs? please say yes.
Anika: Please keep it PG and inclusive — Ops reserves right to remove anything that violates code of conduct.
Lila: Also can we do a mini contest: Best Mug Design, Best Cookie, Most Likely to Be Re-gifted? Winner gets a tiny trophy sticker.
Omar: votes for 'Most Likely to Be Re-gifted' category. I have a vintage mug with a cat wearing sunglasses.
Mara: We'll run quick polls after tasting. Shortlists will be posted in #random and winners announced before 1pm.
KitchenBot: Reminder scheduled: 1767230967 -> 1767234367 (24h left).
Tom: FYI I have a small batch of gluten-free shortbreads, label will say `GF`.
Kate: Shipping help: remote folks, DM me by Monday EOD and I'll coordinate a pickup window at main office.
Anika: Also if anyone wants to submit a non-cookie treat (savory biscotti, spiced nuts) that's fine. Just label allergens.
Lila: Adding a holiday playlist link in thread: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/holiday-redwood (curated by office DJ).
Omar: bringing a pun sticker pack to stick on mugs for people who want to personalize.
Mara: Please avoid open flames in the kitchen. No candles on the swap table.
Anika: Great point — no candles. Safety first.
Tom: Count me in for the mug design contest. I have glitter. (apologies in advance) :sweat_smile:
Anika: Glitter accepted if contained. We'll have cleanup wipes.
Mara: Final logistics: drop off 12:15, tasting 12:30, poll closes 12:55, winners at 12:58. PDF gallery shared afterwards.
Lila: This is delightful. thanks Anika for organizing! :heart: 
Anika: Thanks everyone! I'll post a final RSVP thread tomorrow AM and pin the format example. :sparkles:
